### build_initial_state { #clerq.ob_atom.OBAtom.build_initial_state }

```python
ob_atom.OBAtom.build_initial_state(initial_state=None)
```

Build the initial density matrix for the atom.

The default is for all of the population to be in ``|0><0|``.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type                  | Description                                                                                            | Default   |
|---------------|-----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| initial_state | list\[float\] \| None | a list or array of populations, length num_states. If not given, all the population starts in level 0. | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type    | Description                                                      |
|--------|---------|------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | qu.Qobj | The initial density matrix, diagonal with the given populations. |
|        | qu.Qobj | It is also stored as ``self.initial_state`` and ``self.rho``.    |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                                |
|--------|------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | ValueError | If ``initial_state`` has the wrong length or its elements do not sum to 1. |

#### Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

- The elements must sum to 1 (as this will be the trace of the
    density matrix).

### get_fields_sum_coherence { #clerq.ob_atom.OBAtom.get_fields_sum_coherence }

```python
ob_atom.OBAtom.get_fields_sum_coherence(states_t=None)
```

Returns the sum coherences of the atom density matrix for each
    field, including the relative strength factors.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type               | Description                                                        | Default   |
|----------|--------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| states_t | np.ndarray \| None | (optional) a states_t object. If not provided, use self.states_t() | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                 |
|--------|------------|---------------------------------------------|
|        | np.ndarray | np.ndarray of shape (num_fields, t_steps+1) |

### set_H_Omega { #clerq.ob_atom.OBAtom.set_H_Omega }

```python
ob_atom.OBAtom.set_H_Omega(rabi_freqs, rabi_freq_t_funcs, rabi_freq_t_args)
```

Set the Rabi frequency part of the interaction Hamiltonian.

Updates each field's Rabi frequency and time function, then rebuilds
the Hamiltonian.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type          | Description                                                                              | Default    |
|-------------------|---------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| rabi_freqs        | list\[float\] | Rabi frequency for each field.                                                           | _required_ |
| rabi_freq_t_funcs | list          | Name of the time function for each field, as in ``clerq.t_funcs`` (e.g. ``"gaussian"``). | _required_ |
| rabi_freq_t_args  | list\[dict\]  | Argument dict for each field's time function.                                            | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                       |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | list   | The list of Rabi frequency Hamiltonian terms, one for each field. |
